journal_lines: §aOpening in the cave wall, timbered and old. §oSmelled of rust and absence. Went in. Found what was left.
§aSomeone dug this and stopped. §oThe tools were still on the floor. The ore they missed was still in the walls.
§aAbandoned shaft. Cart on the tracks, half-full. Wood gone soft, ore still sound. Took the ore.
§aTheir pickaxe was leaning against the wall where they had left it. §oI had no use for it. The ore behind it I did.
§aWalked a tunnel someone had hewn and left. §oThe work was careful. Whoever they were, they knew their craft.
§aLadder rungs half-rotted. Climbed down by feel. The ore at the bottom had been waiting.
§aA handprint in the dust near the floor of the shaft. §oSmall. Did not disturb it. Took the ore. Left the print.
§aThe tunnel ended at a wall they had been about to break through. §oFinished the job. The ore behind it was worth finishing.
